meaning: The Enclave the grant is made to.
The model key wrapped to the enclave's encryption key: a version 1 envelope of 105 bytes.
The owner's wallet, or the Enclave account of the enclave that passed the key on.
The slot the grant was written in.
True once the owner has revoked the grant.
Optional lower operator share quoted by the enclave operator for this grant, in basis points (at most `model.operator_share_bps`). `None` uses `model.operator_share_bps`.
